method: Same frozen source snapshots and model settings as the previous failed cases. A local recording relay forwards model request bodies unchanged; DOM timings include relay overhead. Sequential fresh Chromium profiles; application cache disabled, upstream caching uncontrolled. Seven passing cases use c86833b. The Korean 15k case was rerun on 89a2982 after a narrow native-root compatibility fix; this is not eight cases measured on the final build. Each result records its build hashes and commit.
settings: Original batch size 3, concurrency 6, timeout 45 s, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, thinking disabled, temperature 0; no source/formatting reductions.
scope: Eight previously failed original-format cases on Linux Chromium; single runs, not a reliability SLA or linguistic-quality certification.
